# MongoDB

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_component_agents.py from xrds/mongodb.meta.yaml; edit the sidecar, not this file. -->

A dedicated MongoDB replica set, one per application environment.

## How it is requested

A `components[]` entry in an app's values file; the airframe-application chart renders the XR in the app's namespace. Wire it into the app with `env[].fromComponent` (never hand-write the derived names).

## Outputs

- `username`: Secret `{name}-app`, key `username`.
- `password`: Secret `{name}-app`, key `password`.
- `uri`: Secret `{name}-app`, key `connectionString.standard`. A full mongodb:// connection string, credentials and all replica set members included. The key itself contains a literal dot - it is one flat Secret key, "connectionString.standard", not a nested field.
- `uriSrv`: Secret `{name}-app`, key `connectionString.standardSrv`. The same connection string, using mongodb+srv:// DNS seedlist discovery instead of listing every member.

## Where named objects come from

- Secret `{name}-app`: created by an operator from the composed MongoDBCommunity.
- Service `{name}-svc`: created by an operator from the composed MongoDBCommunity.

## Conditions

Besides Crossplane's Ready and Synced. Reasons are a closed set:

- `ComponentReady`: `MongoDBReady` (True), `MongoDBFailed` (False), `MongoDBPending` (False), `MongoDBProvisioning` (False).

## Verify a live XR

```
tools/airframe-verify mongodb <namespace>/<name> [--context CTX]
```

Read-only. Steps, after the implicit `xr-synced` check:

- `xr-ready` (condition): The MongoDB XR's ComponentReady condition has reason MongoDBReady.
- `secret-exists` (secretKeys): Secret {name}-app exists in the app namespace and has non-empty username, password and connectionString.standard keys.
- `reachable` (tcp): A replica-set member behind {name}-svc accepts a TCP connection on 27017, through kubectl port-forward, so it proves the server is listening, not that the app namespace's NetworkPolicy admits the app.

## Editing this composition

- Edit `compositions/mongodb/templates/`, never the inline blocks in `composition.yaml`: `python3 tools/build-compositions mongodb` splices them.
- `python3 tools/test_compositions.py --update mongodb` regenerates `example/expected/`; review that diff like code, it is the behaviour change.
- `python3 tools/test_sidecars.py` fails if a template change breaks a name this sidecar promises.
- Shared with other compositions (symlinks into `compositions/_shared/`): `00-readiness-context.yaml`.
- The operator merges the statefulSet override field by field (MCK pkg/util/merge), so a probe override only needs the fields it changes. kind-prod pins spec.mongoVersion to 7.0 for a kernel bug.
